<div class="op-home">

    <h1>Modular, reproducible pipelines for<br><em>single-cell and spatial</em> data.</h1>
    <p class="lede">From raw counts to an interpretable data object, OpenPipelines reliable and robustly processes your data.</p>
    <div class="modalities">
      <span class="m"><b>RNA</b></span>
      <span class="m"><b>Protein</b> (ADT)</span>
      <span class="m"><b>ATAC</b></span>
      <span class="m"><b>VDJ</b></span>
      <span class="m"><b>GDO</b></span>
      <span class="m"><b>Spatial</b></span>

  <section class="block alt">
    <div class="wrap">
      <div class="sec-head">
        <span class="kicker">Why OpenPipelines?</span>
        <h2>What makes it different?</h2>
        <p>Design choices that set OpenPipelines apart from a typical analysis pipeline.</p>
      </div>
      <div class="features">
        <div class="feature">
          <b>True modularity</b>
          <p>Modular code and execution. Every step is a self-contained component that can be run independently or used as a dependency.</p>
        </div>
        <div class="feature">
          <b>Standard multi-omics data format</b>
          <p>Every component and workflow uses the same format (MuData), so any two can be chained together. All modalities are stored in one place, enabling multi-modal analysis.</p>
        </div>
        <div class="feature">
          <b>Reproducible</b>
          <p>Every component has it's own container with fixed dependencies and every package is versioned letting you trust what tools are being used.</p>
        </div>
        <div class="feature">
          <b>Scalable &amp; portable</b>
          <p>Built on Nextflow, the same workflow runs on a laptop, an HPC cluster, or the cloud.</p>
        </div>
        <div class="feature">
          <b>Best practices by default</b>
          <p>Software-engineering rigor brought to bioinformatics, following the single-cell community's analysis best practices.</p>
        </div>
        <div class="feature">
          <b>Community-driven, team-maintained</b>
          <p>Open source and built for the long haul. Code is publicly available and actively maintained.</p>
        </div>
      </div>
      <p class="ways-note">The <a href="concepts/index.html">concepts</a> pages explains these in more detail.</p>
    </div>
  </section>

        <h2>Local, cloud, or no-code</h2>
        <p>Every workflow is a containerized Nextflow pipeline built using <b>Viash</b>, so the same workflow runs on your laptop, on Seqera Cloud or through the Viash Hub web interface.</p>
      </div>

        <div class="way">
